responses: Hi! I'm the AG Parking assistant. Ask me about slot availability, parking locations, bookings, cancellations, or your account.
Hello! How can I help with parking today?
Hey there! I can help with availability, locations, bookings, vehicles, or general parking questions.
You're welcome! Anything else I can help with?
Happy to help!
Anytime — let me know if you need anything else.
Goodbye! Drive safe.
See you next time!
Take care!

Booking is always for right now — there's no advance/scheduled booking. Pick an available slot, then choose a saved vehicle or enter a new one, and book it immediately. It stays in "Booked" status for 1 hour — if you don't check in within that hour it auto-expires and the slot is released. You can only have one "Booked" reservation waiting for check-in at a time.

You can cancel a booking any time while it's still "Booked" (before check-in) from My Bookings → Cancel. Once it's "Active" (checked in), it can't be cancelled — you'll need to check out normally. There's no cancellation fee since payment only happens at checkout.

Check-in is done by staff at the check-in console using your booking ID or vehicle details — you don't check in yourself in the app. It moves your booking from "Booked" to "Active" and the slot from "Booked" to "Occupied". If your 1-hour window passes first, the booking auto-expires.

Check-out is done by staff when you're leaving. Billing is a minimum of 1 hour, rounded UP to the next hour, at the slot's hourly rate (rates vary by slot type). Check-out marks the booking "Completed", generates a receipt, and frees the slot back to Available.

You can save multiple vehicles under Profile → My Vehicles and pick one instantly when booking. Supported categories are 2 Wheeler, 3 Wheeler, and 4 Wheeler. If a vehicle has no plate yet, check "Registration Pending". You can also scan a plate photo (camera icon next to the registration field) to auto-fill the number. Saved vehicles can be edited or removed any time.

You can update your name/photo from Profile, change your password from Profile → Security, and change your email from Profile (this requires OTP verification of the new address). Accounts can be permanently deleted from Profile → Danger Zone by re-entering your password — this is irreversible.

When adding or booking a vehicle, tap the camera icon next to the registration field and take a clear, well-lit photo of the plate. The number is extracted automatically — you can still edit it if anything looks off.

At the check-in console, look up the user's pending "Booked" booking by booking ID or vehicle details, verify the vehicle matches, then confirm check-in. This moves the booking to "Active" and the slot to "Occupied".

At the check-out console, find the user's "Active" booking and confirm check-out. The system calculates the bill (minimum 1 hour, rounded up to the next hour at the slot's rate), marks the booking "Completed", generates a receipt, and frees the slot.

From the Admin dashboard you can add, edit, or deactivate parking slots — setting the slot type (standard/faculty/disabled/ev), location, and hourly rate. Deactivated slots stop appearing as bookable but keep their history.

From the Admin dashboard you can change a user's role between user/staff/admin (this moves them between the Users and Staff sections automatically) and activate or deactivate accounts. When you promote someone to staff, you also assign them to one parking location — they'll only manage check-in/check-out and slots for that location.

Under Nearby Parking you can search by your current GPS location or by typing a place/address, and see every active parking location within up to 5 km, nearest first — each card shows live available slots and rates. Tap a location to see its slots and book, or get in-app directions to it.

From Admin → Locations you can add, edit, or deactivate parking locations — setting the name, address, map coordinates, and amenities. Each location can have its own slots and its own assigned staff, and Admin → Location Revenue breaks down earnings site-by-site. Staff are assigned (or reassigned) to a location from Admin → Users, not from Locations itself — promote a user to staff, or edit an existing staff member, and pick their location there.

A booking only shows "Cancelled" if it was cancelled manually while still "Booked" — by you, or by staff/admin on your behalf — that never happens on its own. It shows "Expired" instead if check-in didn't happen within 1 hour of booking; the slot is then automatically released back to other users. Either way, no charge applies, since billing only happens at checkout, which needs an actual check-in first.

Your booking's QR code is only shown while it's still "Booked" — open My Bookings, find that booking, and tap "Show Entry QR". It disappears once staff check you in (status moves to "Active") since it's no longer needed, and it won't appear at all if the booking already expired or was cancelled. If it's still "Booked" and you still don't see it, refresh My Bookings first.

If QR Check-In's camera isn't picking up a code, check that camera permission is granted, the code is well-lit, filling the frame, and not showing screen glare. QR Check-In is only an additional way to check bookings in — the regular Check-In page (look up by booking ID or vehicle details) always still works if scanning keeps failing.

Your Check-In queue only ever shows "Booked" bookings for your own assigned location — a booking made for a different location will never appear there, by design. Otherwise, it may have already auto-expired (a booking only holds for 1 hour before check-in), already been checked in, or be hidden by a search/filter you've set — clear the search box; the queue also updates live as new bookings come in.

There's no separate overstay fee or manual penalty to apply — check-out billing is always calculated automatically from the vehicle's actual check-in to check-out time, minimum 1 hour rounded up, no matter how long it stayed. Don't edit an overstaying booking manually; just check it out as normal once the driver returns, and flag anything that looks genuinely wrong to an admin instead of changing it yourself.

For anything I can't resolve here — account access problems, a role or location assignment that looks wrong, billing disputes, or anything else — use Profile → Help & Support → Email Support to reach our team directly. If it's specifically about your staff account or location assignment, an admin manages that and can also help directly.
